items.title: Move the review_run_start clean-tree preflight to BEFORE captureReviewRunSnapshot
items.context: In packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts review_run_start: relocate the B-7691 preflight block (preflightRoot + readGitStatusLines(signedWorkspaceRoot) + classifyGitStatusRows + isBlockingDirty + the blocking throw) to immediately AFTER the REVIEW phase check (the `if (preflightStory.phase !== 'REVIEW')` block) and BEFORE the `const lane = ...` / `captureReviewRunSnapshot(...)` lines. Pure relocation of the existing logic -- do NOT change isBlockingDirty, the DIRTY_GATE_POLICY table, classifierOptionsForCheck, the DONE gate, materialHash computation, or the evidence-write-time freshness guard. Update the trailing comment (it currently says 'proceed to the snapshot' from the wrong position). Verify tsc + the existing review-run-clean-tree-preflight smoke still pass.
items.userSees: On a blocking dirty material-source tree, review_run_start prints "git working tree has uncommitted ... changes" before any review run is created.

happy.desc: Blocking dirty material-source changes are rejected by review_run_start before a reviewer run is persisted.

edge.desc: Unreadable git-status remains fail-open and reaches the existing snapshot diagnostic path rather than changing classifier semantics.

adversarial.desc: The relocation does not alter DIRTY_GATE_POLICY, isBlockingDirty, materialHash computation, or evidence freshness behavior.

verificationEvidence.note: PASS: scenario (i) and material-source dirty scenarios prove review_run_start rejects blocking dirty material-source changes before any reviewer run is persisted.
PASS: scenario (h) keeps unreadable git-status fail-open behavior covered without changing dirty classifier semantics.
PASS: TypeScript build and field regression smoke verify the relocation/comment update does not alter dirty policy, material hash, or review-run persistence side effects.

items.title: Strengthen the smoke to assert the preflight precedes captureReviewRunSnapshot
items.context: Extend packages/main/src/tasks/review-run-clean-tree-preflight-smoke.ts with an ORDERING assertion that would have caught this bug: prove that on a BLOCKING dirty tree, review_run_start refuses BEFORE captureReviewRunSnapshot runs (e.g. assert the thrown error is the preflight 'uncommitted ... changes' error and that NO review run / snapshot-derived artifact was produced; or drive a fixture where reaching captureReviewRunSnapshot would produce a distinguishable outcome). Keep all existing scenarios (a)-(h) green. The goal is an end-to-end ordering check, not the prior isolation-only fail-open unit test.
items.userSees: The review-run clean-tree preflight smoke fails if captureReviewRunSnapshot can run before the dirty-tree preflight refusal.

happy.desc: The smoke asserts the preflight dirty-tree error wins before snapshot-derived behavior and no review run is persisted.

edge.desc: Existing clean-tree preflight scenarios continue to pass after the ordering assertion is added.

adversarial.desc: A regression that moves the preflight after captureReviewRunSnapshot would fail the smoke through observable CLI output and persisted artifact checks.

verificationEvidence.note: PASS: new scenario (i) asserts the preflight dirty-tree error wins before snapshot-derived missing_material_hash diagnostics and records no review run.
PASS: existing scenarios (a)-(h) continue to pass after adding the ordering regression assertion.
PASS: broader field regression smoke accepts the new pre-snapshot dirty refusal and would catch review-run diagnostic/persistence regressions.
